description: Creates a stable private download of a saved board as a manufacturing ZIP or editable .egb project backup. Read get_board for expectedRevision. Use format egb directly for project backups, including empty or incomplete projects and unapplied geometry or electrical changes; no layout generation or check is required. Manufacturing ZIPs require a current saved layout with applied electrical requirements; generate and wait for completion when needed, then read the new revision. New exports require current board access. Issued download links have no automatic expiry and retain this exact export after board edits, deletion, guest claim or cleanup. Only explicit download-link revocation or deletion of the exported file ends access. Keep each complete private URL unchanged, including its fragment; anyone with it can download the file.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

expectedRevision.description: Revision from get_board. A mismatch returns revision_conflict; read the board again before exporting.

format.description: manufacturing: ZIP with Gerber, drill, BOM and placement files. egb: editable EasyGerber board file.

name: export_board
title: Export board files
